subject: RStan2.11.1 - error while running GP example from manual

messages.author: 0127971b69989dcf
messages.subject: RStan2.11.1 - error while running GP example from manual
parts:
Hi,
I've encountered a problem while trying to replicate Gaussian Process simulation from the Users Guide (p. 167). I was trying to get used to the new syntax and redo some familiar analyses the new way, and this one seems broken.
Interestingly when I change ' i==j ? 0.1 : 0.0' to old version 'if_else(i==j, 0.1, 0.0)', I'm getting warnings from the parser, but everything works fine. 
I haven't seen similar topic, so I thought I'll let you know. 

Best,
Wiktor

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] RStan2.11.1 - error while running GP example from manual
parts:
Thanks for reporting.

Can you send the whole example program?

Do you get the same result if you put parens
around it, as in the following?

(i==j ? 0.1 : 0.0)

The ternary operator binds very weakly, so it may just
be a bug in the manual code.

- Bob

parts:
Including parens solved the issue - then it is perhaps error in the manual. Anyway thanks!
I've included the faulty example at the bottom of the previous post. Now the example look like this:

simulate_gp = "
data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  real x[N];
}
transformed data {
  vector[N] mu;
  cov_matrix[N] Sigma;
  for (i in 1:N) 
    mu[i] = 0;
  for (i in 1:N) 
    for (j in 1:N)
      Sigma[i,j] = exp(-pow(x[i] - x[j],2))
